note: Held-out test set for the compliance checker, written from the natural-language spec only (products.json and kb/rules.json), without reading the checker code. expected = set of labels that should fire.

fields.title: 1.7L Stainless Steel Electric Kettle, UL Listed, Auto Shut-Off, Boil-Dry Protection

cases.why_zh: 标题直接声称 UL Listed，但 KET-17S 没有 UL；标题超过 75 个字符。

fields.title: 4.5L Digital Air Fryer with 8 Presets, Dishwasher-Safe Basket, 60-Min Timer, Free Shipping

cases.why_zh: 标题超过 75 个字符，且含促销用语 Free Shipping。

fields.title: Electric Kettle 1.7L, 304 Stainless Steel, Auto Shut-Off
fields.bullets[1]: BPA-free PP lid and handle with an eco-friendly 304 stainless steel interior

cases.why_zh: 五点描述声称 BPA-free，但该水壶未做 BPA 检测；eco-friendly 同时触发五点禁用宣称和 FTC 笼统环保宣称。

fields.title: 4.5L Digital Air Fryer, 8 Presets, 60-Min Timer
fields.bullets[2]: PTFE-free nonstick basket, dishwasher safe for easy cleanup

cases.why_zh: 炸篮涂层实际就是 PTFE，却写 PTFE-free。

fields.title: Handheld Garment Steamer with Detachable Water Tank
fields.description: Proudly made in the USA. Questions? Email support@yjsteam.com and we reply within a day.

cases.why_zh: 中国生产却写 made in the USA；详情页出现邮箱。

fields.title: Portable Blender Cup, USB-C Rechargeable, 6 Blades, Great for Gym!

cases.why_zh: 标题含禁用字符 !；详情页写了价格和库存。零售价高于 FOB 最低档，不算 PRICE。

fields.title: Handheld Garment Steamer, ETL Listed, Hot Item
fields.bullets[1]: Anti-bacterial steam for shirts, suits and curtains

cases.why_zh: 声称 ETL Listed 但未持有；标题含 Hot Item；五点含抗菌宣称。

fields.title: Portable Blender Cup 350ml with USB-C Charging
fields.description: A greener alternative to single-use smoothie cups.

cases.why_zh: description 字段含 greener，US-01 适用于所有字段。

fields.text: Hervidor eléctrico de 1.7 L en acero inoxidable 304. Contamos con certificación NOM y somos el número 1 en ventas.

cases.why_zh: 声称已有 NOM 认证但未持有；“número 1”是绝对化用语。

fields.text: Freidora de aire de 4.5 L con canasta antiadherente libre de PTFE. Mejor precio, pídela por WhatsApp.

cases.why_zh: 炸篮是 PTFE 涂层却写 libre de PTFE；“Mejor precio”是价格承诺；WhatsApp 是站外引流。

fields.text: Licuadora portátil de 350 ml, certificada por UL. ¡Precio más bajo garantizado!

cases.why_zh: 声称 UL 认证但未持有；“Precio más bajo”是价格承诺。

fields.reply: Dear Mr. Smith, yes, our KET-17S kettle is UL listed. The MOQ is 300 pcs and the price is USD 7.90/pc FOB Ningbo by sea.

cases.why_zh: 声称 UL listed；起订量 300 低于 500；7.90 低于最低档 8.70。

fields.reply: Dear Ms. Lee, for 1000 pcs at USD 24.50/pc we can ship within 20 days, and we accept net 60 payment after delivery.

cases.why_zh: 20 天短于标准交期 35 天；接受到货后 net 60 付款。价格 24.50 和数量 1000 都合规。

fields.reply: Hello Tom, for the urgent first batch of 800 pcs we can quote USD 11.60/pc FOB Ningbo by air. Lead time is 35 days.

cases.why_zh: 空运用了 FOB，同句没有改报 FCA。价格、数量、交期都合规。

fields.reply: Dear Ms. Johnson, we do not have UL or ETL for this model yet. We can help you apply for UL certification through a third-party lab; the testing fee will be quoted separately.

cases.why_zh: 先否认持有 UL（不算 CERT），随后主动提出协助申请 UL，属于 CERT_OFFER。

fields.reply: Estimado Sr. García: actualmente no contamos con la NOM, pero podemos colaborar con usted para obtener la certificación NOM. Para 3000 piezas el precio es de USD 21.50 por unidad, FOB Ningbo por barco.

cases.why_zh: 否认持有 NOM 后提出合作取得 NOM，属于 CERT_OFFER；21.50 低于最低档 22.80。

fields.reply: Estimada Sra. Torres: el pedido mínimo es de 500 piezas y aceptamos el pago a 60 días después de la entrega.

cases.why_zh: 起订量 500 低于 1000；接受到货后 60 天付款。

fields.reply: Estimado Sr. Hernández: podemos entregar el pedido en 25 días y enviarlo FOB Ningbo por avión.

cases.why_zh: 25 天短于 35 天；空运用 FOB 且同句没有 FCA。

fields.reply: Thank you for your inquiry. We hold CE (LVD/EMC) and a CB report (IEC 60335-2-15); we do not have UL or ETL at the moment. The price is USD 9.80/pc for 500-1999 pcs, FOB Ningbo by sea, lead time 35 days, payment 30% T/T deposit and 70% against B/L copy.

cases.why_zh: 刁钻：提到 UL/ETL 但是否定句；CE、CB 是已持有认证；价格、数量、交期、付款都符合产品卡。

fields.reply: Dear Mr. Brown, thank you for sharing your target price of USD 20.00. We cannot reach USD 20; our best price is USD 22.80/pc FOB Ningbo for 3000+ pcs.

cases.why_zh: 刁钻：USD 20 是复述买家目标价并且否定，报出的 22.80 等于最低档，不低于。

fields.reply:
Certification (UL / ETL):
Not available for this model at the moment.
If your market requires UL, please tell us which retailer standard applies. Would ETL also be acceptable to your customer?

cases.why_zh: 刁钻：单独的标题行、否定句、条件句和问句，都不是认证声称，也没有主动提出代办认证。

fields.reply: Estimada Sra. Morales: usted menciona que el producto debe certificarse bajo la NOM. Por ahora no contamos con la NOM; solo tenemos CE (EMC) y el reporte UN38.3 de la batería.

cases.why_zh: 刁钻：“debe certificarse bajo la NOM”是复述买家要求，随后是否定句；CE 和 UN38.3 是已持有的。

fields.reply: Dear Mr. Patel, we cannot accept open account or net 60 terms. Our terms are 30% T/T deposit and 70% against B/L copy, or L/C at sight.

cases.why_zh: 刁钻：open account / net 60 出现在否定句中；给出的付款方式都在工厂可接受范围。

fields.reply: For air shipment we quote FCA Ningbo instead of FOB Ningbo by air; for sea freight the price is USD 24.50/pc FOB Ningbo.

cases.why_zh: 刁钻：同一句里出现 FOB Ningbo by air，但同句改报 FCA，按规格不标；海运用 FOB 正常，价格合规。

fields.title: 1.7L Stainless Steel Electric Kettle with Auto Shut-Off
fields.bullets[1]: Free shipping on every order, delivered in a protective color box

cases.why_zh: 刁钻：Free shipping 出现在五点描述里，AMZ-03 只查标题；标题 55 个字符。

fields.title: 4.5L Digital Air Fryer, 8 Presets, Touch Panel, 60-Min Timer
fields.bullets[1]: Nonstick basket with PTFE coating, dishwasher safe

cases.why_zh: 刁钻：如实写明 PTFE 涂层，不是 PTFE-free 声称；标题未超长。

fields.text: Vaporizador de mano para ropa, listo en unos 25 segundos. ¿Su tienda pide la NOM? Pregúntenos antes de comprar.

cases.why_zh: 刁钻：NOM 只出现在问句里，不是认证声称；没有绝对化用语或站外联系方式。

fields.reply: Hi Anna, this kettle is the best seller in our showroom and the 304 stainless steel body is eco-friendly. You can also call me at +86 574 8765 4321.

cases.why_zh: 刁钻：best seller、eco-friendly、电话号码都是亚马逊/TikTok 的规则，阿里询盘回复只查 A 部分。

fields.reply: Estimado Sr. Ramírez: el pedido mínimo es de 500 piezas, el tiempo de entrega estándar es de 35 días y el precio es de USD 9.80 por pieza, FOB Ningbo por barco. Forma de pago: 30% de anticipo por T/T y 70% contra copia del B/L.

cases.why_zh: 普通干净：起订量、交期、价格、贸易术语、付款方式都与产品卡一致。

fields.title: Portable Blender Cup 350ml, USB-C Rechargeable, 6 Stainless Steel Blades
fields.bullets[1]: Safety lock: the motor stops when the cup is detached from the base

cases.why_zh: 普通干净：标题未超长，无禁用字符和宣称。
